We close the shop, set up the tables, and build a hands-on plant-potting experience around your group. You bring the people. We handle the rest.

The Experience

What a private plant bar looks like

01

You Call, We Plan

Tell us your date, group size, and what you're celebrating. We'll suggest an activity, talk through pricing, and confirm everything over the phone. No online forms, no waiting for email replies.

02

We Set the Stage

We close the shop to outside customers and set up a plant bar with everything your group needs — labeled plants to choose from, pots, soil, tools, and a welcome drink station. The shop feels cozy and intentional, not like a craft store.

03

Everyone Takes Home a Plant

Each guest pots their own plant — choosing their plant, their pot, and their soil. We walk everyone through the process together and answer questions. The whole thing takes about 90 minutes to 2 hours. Everyone leaves with a wrapped plant and a care card.

Good Reasons to Gather

We've hosted all kinds of events.

🎂

Birthday Parties

Adults only or mixed ages — both work well. A plant party is a great alternative to a restaurant dinner or bar night. People love having something to take home.

🌿

Team Outings

A genuinely fun alternative to happy hour. Everyone pots a plant to take back to their desk — it becomes a standing reminder of a good afternoon away from the office.

🌸

Baby & Bridal Showers

Guests leave with a plant instead of a party favor. We can suggest pet-safe or nursery-safe plant options for the guest of honor and personalize the whole setup around the theme.

👩‍👩‍👧

Girls' Night Out

A plant bar, some good wine (bring your own — we're BYOB), and two hours away from everything else. Book a weeknight and have the whole shop to yourselves.

🏫

School & Youth Groups

We've hosted 4-H groups, school science classes, and summer camp field trips. Younger kids do best with the succulent bowl format. Call to discuss age-appropriate options.

🎉

Just Because

You don't need a special occasion. Some people book a plant bar just because they want a unique night out with friends. That's our favorite kind of event.

Common Questions

Before you call

How far in advance do I need to book?

We recommend at least two to three weeks out, especially for weekend dates. Summer and fall book fast. If you have something coming up sooner, call anyway — we'll do our best to make it work.

Can we bring our own food and drinks?

Yes. Juniper Lane is BYOB-friendly and you're welcome to bring any food you like. We provide coffee, tea, and sparkling water; the Premium package includes a toast. You can absolutely bring a birthday cake or catered snacks — just let us know ahead of time so we can set up appropriately.

What if someone in our group is allergic to plants?

Let us know when you book and we'll work with you. Most of our tropical houseplants are low-allergen. We can curate the selection to avoid known triggers and make sure there's something appropriate for everyone in the group.

Can we do a theme?

Yes! We've done jungle themes, fall harvest vibes, minimalist all-white setups, and more. We can adjust pot selections, top dressings, table decor, and plant varieties to fit a theme. Tell us your vision when you call and we'll figure out how to make it work within reason.

Do you travel or do events off-site?

We're set up best at the shop — it's where all our supplies, plants, and tables are. We don't currently offer off-site events, but if you have a venue in mind and a large enough group, give us a call and we can at least have the conversation.

What's your cancellation policy?

We ask for a 50% deposit to hold a date, and we require at least one week's notice to cancel or reschedule for a full refund of the deposit. Life happens — just call us as early as possible and we'll do our best to work with you.

Ready to book your plant bar?

Call us to check availability and get your date on the calendar. We make the whole process easy.
